label: ck-kpis/outcomes
sql:
SELECT
  countIf(at >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}) AS closed,
  countIf(at >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND outcome = 'resolved') AS resolved,
  countIf(at < {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}) AS closed_prev,
  countIf(at < {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND outcome = 'resolved') AS resolved_prev
FROM (SELECT trace_id,
    min(row_at) AS at, argMax(r.outcome, toUInt64(r.sent) * 9223372036854775808 + toUInt64(dateDiff('millisecond', toDateTime64(0, 3), r.row_at)) * 1048576 + cityHash64(r.outcome) % 1048576) AS outcome
  FROM (
    SELECT e.TraceId AS trace_id, t.OccurredAt AS row_at, e.Label AS outcome,
      0 AS sent
    FROM (
      SELECT TraceId, OccurredAt
      FROM trace_metrics
      WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})) AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
    ) AS t
    INNER JOIN (
      SELECT TraceId, Label
      FROM evaluation_metrics
      WHERE evaluation_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}))
        AND EvaluatorName = 'Conversation Outcome Judge'
        AND Label != '')
    ) AS e ON e.TraceId = t.TraceId
    UNION ALL
    SELECT TraceId AS trace_id, OccurredAt AS row_at, MetadataOutcome AS outcome,
      1 AS sent
    FROM trace_metrics
    WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})) AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
      AND MetadataOutcome != '')
  ) AS r
  GROUP BY trace_id)

label: ck-kpis/checks
sql:
SELECT
  sumIf(c.pass, t.at >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}) AS passed,
  sumIf(c.n, t.at >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}) AS judged,
  sumIf(c.pass, t.at < {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}) AS passed_prev,
  sumIf(c.n, t.at < {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}) AS judged_prev
FROM (
  SELECT TraceId, OccurredAt AS at
  FROM trace_metrics
  WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})) AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
) AS t
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT TraceId, countIf(Passed = 1) AS pass, count() AS n
    FROM evaluation_metrics
    WHERE evaluation_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}))
      AND Passed IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT IsGuardrail
      AND EvaluatorName != 'Conversation Outcome Judge')
    GROUP BY TraceId
) AS c ON c.TraceId = t.TraceId

label: ck-attention/segments
sql:
SELECT if(g.customer != '', g.customer, coalesce(nullIf(p.TopicName, ''), nullIf(g.meta_topic, ''), 'No topic')) AS segment,
  if(g.customer != '', 'customer', 'topic') AS kind,
  sum(g.pass) AS pass, sum(g.n) AS n, sum(g.base_pass) AS base_pass, sum(g.base_n) AS base_n
FROM (
  SELECT t.customer AS customer, t.topic_id AS topic_id, t.meta_topic AS meta_topic,
    sumIf(c.pass, t.at >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}) AS pass,
    sumIf(c.n, t.at >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}) AS n,
    sumIf(c.pass, t.at < {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}) AS base_pass,
    sumIf(c.n, t.at < {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}) AS base_n
  FROM (
    SELECT TraceId, OccurredAt AS at, ifNull(CustomerId, '') AS customer, TopicId AS topic_id,
      MetadataTopic AS meta_topic
    FROM trace_metrics
    WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})) AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
  ) AS t
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT TraceId, countIf(Passed = 1) AS pass, count() AS n
    FROM evaluation_metrics
    WHERE evaluation_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}))
      AND Passed IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT IsGuardrail
      AND EvaluatorName != 'Conversation Outcome Judge')
    GROUP BY TraceId
  ) AS c ON c.TraceId = t.TraceId
  GROUP BY customer, topic_id, meta_topic
) AS g
LEFT JOIN topics AS p ON p.TopicId = g.topic_id
GROUP BY segment, kind
ORDER BY n DESC
LIMIT 50

label: ck-attention/reasons
sql:
SELECT reason, outcome,
  countIf(at >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}) AS now,
  countIf(at < {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}) AS before
FROM (SELECT trace_id,
    min(row_at) AS at, argMax(r.outcome, toUInt64(r.sent) * 9223372036854775808 + toUInt64(dateDiff('millisecond', toDateTime64(0, 3), r.row_at)) * 1048576 + cityHash64(r.outcome, r.reason) % 1048576) AS outcome, argMax(r.reason, toUInt64(r.sent) * 9223372036854775808 + toUInt64(dateDiff('millisecond', toDateTime64(0, 3), r.row_at)) * 1048576 + cityHash64(r.outcome, r.reason) % 1048576) AS reason
  FROM (
    SELECT e.TraceId AS trace_id, t.OccurredAt AS row_at, e.Label AS outcome, e.Label AS reason,
      0 AS sent
    FROM (
      SELECT TraceId, OccurredAt
      FROM trace_metrics
      WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})) AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
    ) AS t
    INNER JOIN (
      SELECT TraceId, Label
      FROM evaluation_metrics
      WHERE evaluation_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}))
        AND EvaluatorName = 'Conversation Outcome Judge'
        AND Label != '')
    ) AS e ON e.TraceId = t.TraceId
    UNION ALL
    SELECT TraceId AS trace_id, OccurredAt AS row_at, MetadataOutcome AS outcome,
      coalesce(nullIf(MetadataOutcomeReason, ''), MetadataOutcome) AS reason,
      1 AS sent
    FROM trace_metrics
    WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})) AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
      AND MetadataOutcome != '')
  ) AS r
  GROUP BY trace_id)
GROUP BY reason, outcome
ORDER BY now DESC
LIMIT 30

label: ck-attention/agreement
sql:
SELECT e.evaluator AS evaluator,
  count() AS audited,
  countIf(e.ok = (a.up = 1)) AS agree,
  countIf(e.ok) AS judge_pass,
  countIf(a.up = 1) AS reviewer_pass
FROM (SELECT
    e.TraceId AS trace_id, t.OccurredAt AS at, e.EvaluatorName AS evaluator, e.Label AS label,
    e.Passed = 1 AS ok, e.Passed IS NOT NULL AND NOT e.IsGuardrail
      AND e.EvaluatorName != 'Conversation Outcome Judge' AS is_check,
    t.customer AS customer
  FROM evaluation_metrics AS e
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT TraceId, OccurredAt, ifNull(CustomerId, '') AS customer
    FROM trace_metrics
    WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
  ) AS t ON t.TraceId = e.TraceId
  WHERE e.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( e.OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime})) AS e
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT TraceId, max(if(IsThumbsUp, 1, 0)) AS up
  FROM annotations
  WHERE (annotations.TenantId, annotations.TraceId) IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1)) AND ( CreatedAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}
    AND IsThumbsUp IS NOT NULL)
  GROUP BY TraceId
) AS a ON a.TraceId = e.trace_id
WHERE e.is_check
GROUP BY evaluator
HAVING audited >= 10
ORDER BY audited DESC
LIMIT 10

label: ck-top-ask/gap
sql:
SELECT g.topic AS topic, g.gaps AS gaps, g.closed AS closed,
  x.input AS example, g.trace_id AS trace_id
FROM (
  SELECT coalesce(nullIf(p.TopicName, ''), nullIf(g.meta_topic, ''), 'No topic') AS topic,
    sum(g.gaps) AS gaps,
    sum(g.closed) AS closed,
    minIf(g.trace_id, g.gaps > 0) AS trace_id
  FROM (
    SELECT topic_id, meta_topic,
      countIf(outcome = 'capability_gap') AS gaps,
      count() AS closed,
      minIf(trace_id, outcome = 'capability_gap') AS trace_id
    FROM (SELECT trace_id,
    min(row_at) AS at, argMax(r.outcome, toUInt64(r.sent) * 9223372036854775808 + toUInt64(dateDiff('millisecond', toDateTime64(0, 3), r.row_at)) * 1048576 + cityHash64(r.outcome) % 1048576) AS outcome, argMin(topic_id, row_at) AS topic_id, argMin(meta_topic, row_at) AS meta_topic
  FROM (
    SELECT e.TraceId AS trace_id, t.OccurredAt AS row_at, e.Label AS outcome, t.topic_id AS topic_id, t.MetadataTopic AS meta_topic,
      0 AS sent
    FROM (
      SELECT TraceId, OccurredAt, ifNull(TopicId, '') AS topic_id, MetadataTopic
      FROM trace_metrics
      WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
    ) AS t
    INNER JOIN (
      SELECT TraceId, Label
      FROM evaluation_metrics
      WHERE evaluation_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}
        AND EvaluatorName = 'Conversation Outcome Judge'
        AND Label != '')
    ) AS e ON e.TraceId = t.TraceId
    UNION ALL
    SELECT TraceId AS trace_id, OccurredAt AS row_at, MetadataOutcome AS outcome, ifNull(TopicId, '') AS topic_id, MetadataTopic AS meta_topic,
      1 AS sent
    FROM trace_metrics
    WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
      AND MetadataOutcome != '')
  ) AS r
  GROUP BY trace_id)
    GROUP BY topic_id, meta_topic
  ) AS g
  LEFT JOIN topics AS p ON p.TopicId = g.topic_id
  GROUP BY topic
  ORDER BY gaps DESC
  LIMIT 20
) AS g
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT TraceId, CapturedInput AS input
  FROM traces
  WHERE (has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') OR (traces.TenantId, traces.TraceId) IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE NOT has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') AND Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1))) AND (traces.TenantId, traces.TraceId) NOT IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') AND Source NOT IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1)) AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
    AND TraceId IN (SELECT trace_id FROM (
      SELECT coalesce(nullIf(p.TopicName, ''), nullIf(g.meta_topic, ''), 'No topic') AS topic,
    sum(g.gaps) AS gaps,
    sum(g.closed) AS closed,
    minIf(g.trace_id, g.gaps > 0) AS trace_id
  FROM (
    SELECT topic_id, meta_topic,
      countIf(outcome = 'capability_gap') AS gaps,
      count() AS closed,
      minIf(trace_id, outcome = 'capability_gap') AS trace_id
    FROM (SELECT trace_id,
    min(row_at) AS at, argMax(r.outcome, toUInt64(r.sent) * 9223372036854775808 + toUInt64(dateDiff('millisecond', toDateTime64(0, 3), r.row_at)) * 1048576 + cityHash64(r.outcome) % 1048576) AS outcome, argMin(topic_id, row_at) AS topic_id, argMin(meta_topic, row_at) AS meta_topic
  FROM (
    SELECT e.TraceId AS trace_id, t.OccurredAt AS row_at, e.Label AS outcome, t.topic_id AS topic_id, t.MetadataTopic AS meta_topic,
      0 AS sent
    FROM (
      SELECT TraceId, OccurredAt, ifNull(TopicId, '') AS topic_id, MetadataTopic
      FROM trace_metrics
      WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
    ) AS t
    INNER JOIN (
      SELECT TraceId, Label
      FROM evaluation_metrics
      WHERE evaluation_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}
        AND EvaluatorName = 'Conversation Outcome Judge'
        AND Label != '')
    ) AS e ON e.TraceId = t.TraceId
    UNION ALL
    SELECT TraceId AS trace_id, OccurredAt AS row_at, MetadataOutcome AS outcome, ifNull(TopicId, '') AS topic_id, MetadataTopic AS meta_topic,
      1 AS sent
    FROM trace_metrics
    WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
      AND MetadataOutcome != '')
  ) AS r
  GROUP BY trace_id)
    GROUP BY topic_id, meta_topic
  ) AS g
  LEFT JOIN topics AS p ON p.TopicId = g.topic_id
  GROUP BY topic
  ORDER BY gaps DESC
  LIMIT 20
    )))
) AS x ON x.TraceId = g.trace_id
ORDER BY gaps DESC

label: ans-outcomes/totals
sql:
SELECT countIf(at >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}) AS closed,
  countIf(at < {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}) AS closed_previous
FROM (
  SELECT c.trace_id AS trace_id,
    c.at AS at,
    c.outcome AS outcome
  FROM (
    SELECT any(r.trace_id) AS trace_id,
      min(r.row_at) AS at,
      argMax(r.outcome, toUInt64(r.sent) * 4611686018427387904 + toUInt64(dateDiff('millisecond', toDateTime64(0, 3), r.row_at))) AS outcome
    FROM (
      SELECT t.TraceId AS trace_id, t.OccurredAt AS row_at,
        ifNull(j.label, '') AS outcome, 0 AS sent
      FROM (
        SELECT TraceId, OccurredAt
        FROM trace_metrics
        WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})) AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
      ) AS t
      INNER JOIN (
        SELECT TraceId, argMax(Label, OccurredAt) AS label
      FROM evaluation_metrics
      WHERE evaluation_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})) AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
        AND EvaluatorName = 'Conversation Outcome Judge')
      GROUP BY TraceId
      ) AS j ON j.TraceId = t.TraceId
      UNION ALL
      SELECT TraceId AS trace_id, OccurredAt AS row_at,
        MetadataOutcome AS outcome, 1 AS sent
      FROM trace_metrics
      WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})) AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
        AND MetadataOutcome != '')
    ) AS r
    GROUP BY sipHash128(r.trace_id)
  ) AS c
)
WHERE outcome != ''

label: ans-topics/topics
sql:
SELECT r.topic AS topic,
  r.requests AS requests,
  ifNull(c.closed, 0) AS closed,
  ifNull(c.resolved, 0) AS resolved,
  ifNull(c.cannot, 0) AS cannot,
  r.checks_passed AS checks_passed,
  r.checks_run AS checks_run
FROM (
  SELECT coalesce(nullIf(p.TopicName, ''), nullIf(t.MetadataTopic, '')) AS topic,
    count() AS requests,
    sum(ifNull(e.passed, 0)) AS checks_passed,
    sum(ifNull(e.runs, 0)) AS checks_run
  FROM trace_metrics AS t
  LEFT JOIN topics AS p ON p.TopicId = t.TopicId
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT TraceId, countIf(Passed = 1) AS passed, count() AS runs
    FROM evaluation_metrics
    WHERE evaluation_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
      AND Passed IS NOT NULL
      AND IsGuardrail = 0
      AND EvaluatorName != 'Conversation Outcome Judge')
    GROUP BY TraceId
  ) AS e ON e.TraceId = t.TraceId
  WHERE t.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( t.OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND t.OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
    AND topic IS NOT NULL)
  GROUP BY topic
) AS r
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT topic,
    countIf(outcome != '') AS closed,
    countIf(outcome = 'resolved') AS resolved,
    countIf(outcome = 'capability_gap') AS cannot
  FROM (
  SELECT c.trace_id AS trace_id,
    c.at AS at,
    k.topic AS topic,
    c.outcome AS outcome
  FROM (
    SELECT any(r.trace_id) AS trace_id,
      min(r.row_at) AS at,
      argMin(cityHash64(r.topic_id, r.meta_topic), r.row_at) AS topic_key,
      argMax(r.outcome, toUInt64(r.sent) * 4611686018427387904 + toUInt64(dateDiff('millisecond', toDateTime64(0, 3), r.row_at))) AS outcome
    FROM (
      SELECT t.TraceId AS trace_id, t.OccurredAt AS row_at, t.topic_id AS topic_id, t.MetadataTopic AS meta_topic,
        ifNull(j.label, '') AS outcome, 0 AS sent
      FROM (
        SELECT TraceId, OccurredAt, ifNull(TopicId, '') AS topic_id, MetadataTopic
        FROM trace_metrics
        WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
      ) AS t
      INNER JOIN (
        SELECT TraceId, argMax(Label, OccurredAt) AS label
      FROM evaluation_metrics
      WHERE evaluation_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
        AND EvaluatorName = 'Conversation Outcome Judge')
      GROUP BY TraceId
      ) AS j ON j.TraceId = t.TraceId
      UNION ALL
      SELECT TraceId AS trace_id, OccurredAt AS row_at, ifNull(TopicId, '') AS topic_id, MetadataTopic AS meta_topic,
        MetadataOutcome AS outcome, 1 AS sent
      FROM trace_metrics
      WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
        AND MetadataOutcome != '')
    ) AS r
    GROUP BY sipHash128(r.trace_id)
  ) AS c
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT cityHash64(m.topic_id, m.meta_topic) AS topic_key,
      any(coalesce(nullIf(p.TopicName, ''), nullIf(m.meta_topic, ''))) AS topic
    FROM (
      SELECT DISTINCT ifNull(TopicId, '') AS topic_id, MetadataTopic AS meta_topic
      FROM trace_metrics
      WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
    ) AS m
    LEFT JOIN topics AS p ON p.TopicId = m.topic_id
    GROUP BY topic_key
  ) AS k ON k.topic_key = c.topic_key
)
  WHERE topic IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY topic
) AS c ON c.topic = r.topic
ORDER BY requests DESC
LIMIT 6

label: cost-verdict/outcomes
sql:
SELECT
  countIf(at >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}) AS closed,
  countIf(at >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND outcome = 'resolved') AS resolved,

  countIf(at < {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND outcome = 'resolved') AS resolved_prev
FROM (SELECT trace_id,
    min(row_at) AS at, argMax(r.outcome, toUInt64(r.sent) * 9223372036854775808 + toUInt64(dateDiff('millisecond', toDateTime64(0, 3), r.row_at)) * 1048576 + cityHash64(r.outcome) % 1048576) AS outcome
  FROM (
    SELECT e.TraceId AS trace_id, t.OccurredAt AS row_at, e.Label AS outcome,
      0 AS sent
    FROM (
      SELECT TraceId, OccurredAt
      FROM trace_metrics
      WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})) AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
    ) AS t
    INNER JOIN (
      SELECT TraceId, Label
      FROM evaluation_metrics
      WHERE evaluation_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}))
        AND EvaluatorName = 'Conversation Outcome Judge'
        AND Label != '')
    ) AS e ON e.TraceId = t.TraceId
    UNION ALL
    SELECT TraceId AS trace_id, OccurredAt AS row_at, MetadataOutcome AS outcome,
      1 AS sent
    FROM trace_metrics
    WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})) AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
      AND MetadataOutcome != '')
  ) AS r
  GROUP BY trace_id)

label: att-table/passRates
sql:
WITH (
  SELECT multiIf(
    countIf(ifNull(CustomerId, '') != '') > 0, 'langwatch.customer_id',
    countIf(MetadataDocumentType != '') > 0, 'metadata.document_type',
    countIf(MetadataLanguage != '') > 0, 'metadata.language',
    countIf(MetadataTeam != '') > 0, 'metadata.team',
    countIf(MetadataFlow != '') > 0, 'metadata.flow',
    countIf(MetadataSegment != '') > 0, 'metadata.segment',
    countIf(MetadataTopic != '') > 0, 'metadata.topic',
    countIf(notEmpty(Labels)) > 0, 'langwatch.labels',
    '')
  FROM trace_metrics
  WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
) AS unit_key
SELECT t.unit AS unit,
  sumIf(t.passed, t.at >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}) AS passed,
  sumIf(t.judged, t.at >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}) AS judged,
  sumIf(t.passed, t.at < {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}) AS passed_before,
  sumIf(t.judged, t.at < {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}) AS judged_before
FROM (
  SELECT t.trace AS trace,
    argMin(t.unit, t.at) AS unit,
    argMin(t.version, t.at) AS version,
    min(t.at) AS at,
    any(e.passed) AS passed,
    any(e.judged) AS judged
  FROM (
    SELECT sipHash128(TraceId) AS trace, multiIf(
    unit_key = 'langwatch.customer_id', ifNull(CustomerId, ''),
    unit_key = 'metadata.document_type', MetadataDocumentType,
    unit_key = 'metadata.language', MetadataLanguage,

label: att-change/units
sql:
WITH (
  SELECT multiIf(
    countIf(ifNull(CustomerId, '') != '') > 0, 'langwatch.customer_id',
    countIf(MetadataDocumentType != '') > 0, 'metadata.document_type',
    countIf(MetadataLanguage != '') > 0, 'metadata.language',
    countIf(MetadataTeam != '') > 0, 'metadata.team',
    countIf(MetadataFlow != '') > 0, 'metadata.flow',
    countIf(MetadataSegment != '') > 0, 'metadata.segment',
    countIf(MetadataTopic != '') > 0, 'metadata.topic',
    countIf(notEmpty(Labels)) > 0, 'langwatch.labels',
    '')
  FROM trace_metrics
  WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
) AS unit_key
SELECT unit_key, t.unit AS unit,
  coalesce(nullIf(t.version, ''), t.managed, '') AS version,
  min(t.at) AS first_seen,
  sum(t.passed) AS passed,
  sum(t.judged) AS judged
FROM (
  SELECT t.trace AS trace,
    argMin(t.unit, t.at) AS unit,
    argMin(t.version, t.at) AS version,
    min(t.at) AS at,
    any(t.managed) AS managed,
    any(e.passed) AS passed,
    any(e.judged) AS judged
  FROM (
    SELECT sipHash128(TraceId) AS trace, multiIf(
    unit_key = 'langwatch.customer_id', ifNull(CustomerId, ''),
    unit_key = 'metadata.document_type', MetadataDocumentType,
    unit_key = 'metadata.language', MetadataLanguage,
    unit_key = 'metadata.team', MetadataTeam,
    unit_key = 'metadata.flow', MetadataFlow,
    unit_key = 'metadata.segment', MetadataSegment,
    unit_key = 'metadata.topic', MetadataTopic,
    unit_key = 'langwatch.labels', Labels[1],
    '') AS unit, MetadataPromptVersion AS version,
      OccurredAt AS at,
      CAST(NULL AS Nullable(String)) AS managed
    FROM trace_metrics
    WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})) AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
    UNION ALL
    SELECT sipHash128(TraceId) AS trace, '' AS unit, '' AS version, toDateTime64('2200-01-01 00:00:00', 3) AS at,
      LastUsedPromptVersionId AS managed
    FROM traces
    WHERE (has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') OR (traces.TenantId, traces.TraceId) IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE NOT has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') AND Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1))) AND (traces.TenantId, traces.TraceId) NOT IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') AND Source NOT IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1)) AND ( OccurredAt >= subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})) AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
      AND LastUsedPromptVersionId != '')
  ) AS t
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT sipHash128(TraceId) AS trace, countIf(Passed = 1) AS passed, count() AS judged
  FROM evaluation_metrics
  WHERE evaluation_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}))
    AND Passed IS NOT NULL
    AND IsGuardrail = false)
  GROUP BY trace
  ) AS e ON e.trace = t.trace
  GROUP BY t.trace
  HAVING at < toDateTime64('2200-01-01 00:00:00', 3)
) AS t
WHERE version != ''
GROUP BY unit, version
LIMIT 500

label: rag-failure-source/trend
sql:
SELECT addSeconds(toStartOfInterval(subtractSeconds(s.at, 345600), INTERVAL {dashboard_context_granularity_seconds:UInt32} SECOND), 345600) AS bucket,
  count() AS searched,
  countIf(s.found_nothing = 1 AND (s.errored = 1 OR ifNull(j.failed, 0) = 1)) AS retrieval,
  countIf(s.found_nothing = 0 AND s.errored = 1) AS errors,
  countIf(s.found_nothing = 0 AND s.errored = 0 AND ifNull(j.failed, 0) = 1) AS generation
FROM (
  SELECT TraceId AS trace_id,
    min(StartTime) AS at,
    max(SpanType = 'rag') AS searched,
    max(SpanType = 'rag' AND RagContextCount = 0) AS found_nothing,
    max(StatusCode = 2) AS errored
  FROM span_metrics
  WHERE (has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') OR (span_metrics.TenantId, span_metrics.TraceId) IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE NOT has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') AND Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1))) AND (span_metrics.TenantId, span_metrics.TraceId) NOT IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') AND Source NOT IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1)) AND ( StartTime >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND StartTime < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
  GROUP BY trace_id
  HAVING searched = 1
) AS s
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT TraceId, max(Passed = 0) AS failed
  FROM evaluation_metrics
  WHERE evaluation_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
    AND Passed IS NOT NULL
    AND IsGuardrail = 0)
  GROUP BY TraceId
) AS j ON j.TraceId = s.trace_id
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket

  countIf(outcome = 'resolved') AS resolved,
  count() AS closed
FROM (SELECT trace_id,
    min(row_at) AS at, argMax(r.outcome, toUInt64(r.sent) * 9223372036854775808 + toUInt64(dateDiff('millisecond', toDateTime64(0, 3), r.row_at)) * 1048576 + cityHash64(r.outcome) % 1048576) AS outcome
  FROM (
    SELECT e.TraceId AS trace_id, t.OccurredAt AS row_at, e.Label AS outcome,
      0 AS sent
    FROM (
      SELECT TraceId, OccurredAt
      FROM trace_metrics
      WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
    ) AS t

      FROM evaluation_metrics
      WHERE evaluation_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}
        AND EvaluatorName = 'Conversation Outcome Judge'
        AND Label != '')
    ) AS e ON e.TraceId = t.TraceId

label: ans-outcomes/trend
sql:
SELECT addSeconds(toStartOfInterval(subtractSeconds(at, 345600), INTERVAL {dashboard_context_granularity_seconds:UInt32} SECOND), 345600) AS bucket,
  count() AS closed,
  countIf(outcome = 'resolved') AS resolved,
  countIf(outcome = 'misunderstood') AS misunderstood,
  countIf(outcome = 'capability_gap') AS capability_gap,
  countIf(outcome = 'refusal') AS refusal,
  countIf(outcome = 'handover') AS handover
FROM (
  SELECT c.trace_id AS trace_id,
    c.at AS at,
    c.outcome AS outcome
  FROM (
    SELECT any(r.trace_id) AS trace_id,
      min(r.row_at) AS at,
      argMax(r.outcome, toUInt64(r.sent) * 4611686018427387904 + toUInt64(dateDiff('millisecond', toDateTime64(0, 3), r.row_at))) AS outcome
    FROM (
      SELECT t.TraceId AS trace_id, t.OccurredAt AS row_at,
        ifNull(j.label, '') AS outcome, 0 AS sent
      FROM (
        SELECT TraceId, OccurredAt
        FROM trace_metrics
        WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
      ) AS t
      INNER JOIN (
        SELECT TraceId, argMax(Label, OccurredAt) AS label
      FROM evaluation_metrics
      WHERE evaluation_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
        AND EvaluatorName = 'Conversation Outcome Judge')
      GROUP BY TraceId
      ) AS j ON j.TraceId = t.TraceId
      UNION ALL
      SELECT TraceId AS trace_id, OccurredAt AS row_at,
        MetadataOutcome AS outcome, 1 AS sent
      FROM trace_metrics
      WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
        AND MetadataOutcome != '')
    ) AS r
    GROUP BY sipHash128(r.trace_id)
  ) AS c
)
WHERE outcome != ''
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket

  countIf(outcome = 'resolved') AS done,
  count() AS calls
FROM (SELECT o.outcome AS outcome, o.at AS at,
    coalesce(nullIf(o.language, ''), 'Unknown') AS language
  FROM (SELECT trace_id,
    min(row_at) AS at, argMax(r.outcome, toUInt64(r.sent) * 9223372036854775808 + toUInt64(dateDiff('millisecond', toDateTime64(0, 3), r.row_at)) * 1048576 + cityHash64(r.outcome) % 1048576) AS outcome, any(language) AS language
  FROM (
    SELECT e.TraceId AS trace_id, t.OccurredAt AS row_at, e.Label AS outcome, t.MetadataLanguage AS language,
      0 AS sent
    FROM (
      SELECT TraceId, OccurredAt, MetadataLanguage
      FROM trace_metrics

    ) AS t
    INNER JOIN (

      WHERE evaluation_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}
        AND EvaluatorName = 'Conversation Outcome Judge'
        AND Label != '')
    ) AS e ON e.TraceId = t.TraceId
    UNION ALL
